title: Vision
summary: Purpose and vision behind church stage productions.
content:
“Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men.” — Colossians 3:23

Vision and Purpose

Every performance we create is a ministry — a visible act of worship that communicates God's story. Our goal is not entertainment but revelation: that through story, song, and movement, audiences encounter truth, grace, and hope.

Why We Perform

  • To glorify God with the gifts He has entrusted to us.
  • To teach biblical truth through creative expression.
  • To unify diverse volunteers under one mission: sharing the Gospel.
  • To serve our congregation and community with excellence and humility.
